caption: The camera orientation has shifted to the right, revealing a portion of the wall in the background. A white remote control has been added to the right side of the pink hair dryer. The blue disinfectant bottle on the left side has been replaced with a purple toy.
The polar bear on the right side of the frame, which was previously facing left with its head slightly lowered and eyes closed, is now looking to the left with its head slightly raised.

The squirrel on the left side of the image has disappeared. A new black bird appears in the background, standing on the grass behind the tree stump. The peanut that was originally in the squirrel's mouth is now placed on the tree stump.
The perspective shifts to a lower angle, altering the viewpoint of the scene.
The scene has become brighter. The camera angle has shifted to the right, revealing a portion of the road in the center of the frame. A yellow snowplow appears on the right side of the screen.
The three people change from facing forward with their arms crossed in front of their chests to turning to the left side of the frame, with their backs to the camera.

The camera lens, which was originally in the lower left corner of the table, has been moved to the right side of the keyboard. The camera body that was previously under the monitor is now placed on the mouse mat. The stacked books and notebooks beneath the monitor are no longer visible. The camera lens and body have swapped positions.

The polar bear on the right side of the frame, which was previously standing with its mouth open and head tilted to the left, is now lying down with its head resting on the snow. The polar bear in the middle of the frame, which was previously lying on the snow with its head facing downward, is now also lying down with its head resting on the snow.

A woman wearing a white top and blue pants appears in front of the stove on the right side of the room, facing the stove with her back to the camera. The word "kitchen" in light blue letters has appeared on the floor in the lower left corner of the scene.

The scene has become more visible. The blue and white striped beach chair moves to the right, away from the picnic mat.The green picnic blanket in the center of the scene changes to a red and white checkered picnic blanket with the word "Picnic" printed on it.
The scene is now more lit up. A person appears in the middle of the road, walking towards the camera and approaching the pedestrian crossing.
The scene has become more tilted.
The scene has become darker. The black table in the front left of the classroom is replaced by a black chair.

The chair on the right side of the round table has disappeared. The chair on the left side of the round table has also disappeared. The transparent glass water jug in the center of the table has been replaced by a white cup. The red kettle on the right-side stove is now green. The brown clock hanging on the wall at the back left of the scene has disappeared.
The scene has become more illuminated.
